analyst_view.overall: Early view: AZ came back from 1-3 to beat Groningen 4-3 and visit Sparta four days before a Europa League trip to Sparta Prague. Sparta lost 3-1 at ADO and were knocked out of the cup by Fortuna, and one report says goalkeeper Brouwer went off with an ankle injury at ADO.

goals.text: The numbers say 3 goals. I lean higher: AZ's games have been open (4-3 v Groningen, 19 shots in the 0-1 loss to Ajax), Sparta conceded three at ADO and scored three at Groningen, and Sparta may be without first-choice keeper Brouwer.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.6 corners. AZ attack a lot down the flanks with Daal and Dijkstra, which supports the figure, and I see nothing to move it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. No bans or special tension point either way; Sparta are mid-table and AZ need points to stay near the top four.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots. I lean higher because AZ shoot often, 19 times even in defeat against Ajax, and Sparta hit the post and kept attacking at ADO.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. AZ's volume is high but their finishing has come and gone, and Kees Smit, back from injury, adds quality; overall the estimate looks right.
